# Check what render_inner_html returns during full conversion
import markdown
from markdown.extensions.toc import render_inner_html, run_postprocessors, striptags

md = markdown.Markdown(extensions=['toc', 'attr_list'])

# Patch TocTreeprocessor.run to see what render_inner_html returns
original_run = md.registeredExtensions[0].TreeProcessorClass.run

def debug_run(self, doc):
    for el in doc.iter():
        if isinstance(el.tag, str) and self.header_rgx.match(el.tag):
            inner_html = render_inner_html(self.md, el)
            print(f"inner_html={inner_html!r}")
            
            processed_text = run_postprocessors(self.md, inner_html)
            print(f"processed_text={processed_text!r}")
            
            text = striptags(processed_text)
            print(f"text={text!r}")
    return original_run(self, doc)

md.registeredExtensions[0].TreeProcessorClass.run = debug_run

text = "# Foo & Bar {:data-toc-label='Custom & Label'}"
result = md.convert(text)
print("\nResult:")
print(result)
